scope: CPU-only four-row Montgomery dot fusion in prepared RNS gadget and S2C matrices.
fixtures: Deterministic noncryptographic gadget rows and zero-initialized Galois fixture keys; same prepared spectra shared by fused and unfused controls.
bound: Canonical operands <p<2^30 imply sum of four raw products <4p^2<p*2^32. Montgomery reduction returns <2p; addition to lazy destination stays <4p<2^32 and reduction restores <2p.
checks: AVX2 eight-lane dot versus independent uint128 modular oracle: all 17 primes, 1024 updates, maximal operands and lazy destinations.
Gadget fused/unfused/independent digit-NTT equality: N=2,4,16,512,16384; zero and sparse nonconsecutive active rows; multiple row-count remainders; primary20 and regrouped40.
S2C fused/unfused/original FFT equality: direct/conjugate, term counts3,4,5,7,8,9, signed int64 and large integer stress.
Factor direct-RNS and digit-CRT byte equality.
timing_method: Unfused/fused/fused/unfused phases, five calls per phase, first omitted, same prepared fixture and input. One P core or eight P cores; sequential runs with no concurrent build. One-core OpenMP places were reduced to the sole allowed core by libgomp.
timing_limitations: Microbenchmarks only. Full-workload qualification recorded separately; these results do not establish total FBS speedup or close the remaining gap.
